terminal_evidence.failure_message_contains: ERROR 000425: Failed to create ortho-corrected raster dataset

official_sources.title: Sentinel-1 GRD workflow
official_sources.relevant_guidance: The documented analysis-ready Sentinel-1 GRD sequence places Despeckle after Apply Radiometric Terrain Flattening and before Apply Geometric Terrain Correction.

official_sources.title: Apply Geometric Terrain Correction (Image Analyst Tools)
official_sources.relevant_guidance: The Usage section directs users to run Despeckle on the input SAR data before Apply Geometric Terrain Correction; the examples use a despeckled input.

official_sources.title: Despeckle (Image Analyst Tools)
official_sources.relevant_guidance: REFINED_LEE is the default edge-preserving option; Esri's Python example calls arcpy.ia.Despeckle(input, 'VV;VH', 'REFINED_LEE') and then saves the returned Raster. Filter size is not valid for REFINED_LEE.

official_sources.title: Generate Radiometric Terrain Corrected Data (Image Analyst Tools)
official_sources.relevant_guidance: The integrated RTC workflow includes Apply Radiometric Terrain Flattening, Despeckle, and Apply Geometric Terrain Correction as successive processing stages.
